colors=[[8,6],[9,4],[7,1]]
shapes={
8:[[1,0,0],[1,1,0],[0,0,1]],
6:[[0,0,1],[1,1,0],[0,0,1]],
9:[[1,0,1],[0,1,0],[1,1,1]],
4:[[1,1,1],[0,1,0],[0,1,1]],
7:[[1,0,0],[0,1,0],[1,1,1]],
1:[[1,1,0],[0,1,0],[0,1,1]],
}
for bi,row in enumerate(colors):
  r0=1+6*bi
  for bj,color in enumerate(row):
    c0=1+6*bj
    out[r0:r0+5,c0:c0+5]=color
    sh=shapes[color]
    for i in range(3):
      for j in range(3):
        if sh[i][j]: out[r0+1+i,c0+1+j]=3
        else: out[r0+1+i,c0+1+j]=color
print(out.shape)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out.tolist()))
